media_reality_contract.principle: Do not prescribe an arbitrary universal image count. The selected benchmark-derived mechanism determines how much media is necessary and how prominent it must feel.
required_page_behavior: Media must create an intentional page-level rhythm rather than stop after isolated hero/body slots.
Image-led/atmospheric benchmark mechanisms must visibly remain image-led in screenshots.
Process/story/human/gallery variants requiring media fail closed when their required visible mechanism cannot be represented truthfully.
Feasibility may select a compatible variant inside the frozen Family; it must never silently shrink an image-dependent mechanism into generic incidental media.
Generic stock may be compositionally strong only as clearly illustrative media; it cannot become company-specific evidence.
hard_return_conditions: assets exist in the bundle but a normal reviewer reasonably perceives imagery as absent or incidental
media appears only as interchangeable bounded slots without narrative/compositional consequence
desktop mechanism depends on media but mobile removes its authority
selected research mechanism requires sensory/environment/process authority and screenshot shows primarily copy/cards instead

section_authorship_contract.rule: Every major section must earn its composition from a decision job and the Page Spine. Authorship is not satisfied by a different class name, border, grid ratio or dark panel alone.
visible_requirements: material/background behavior tied to persuasion state
a reason the section could not be swapped unchanged into an unrelated page

typography_material_spacing_contract.typography: Type must establish page-specific authority through scale relationship, voice, measure and contrast—not only shared serif/sans variables.
typography_material_spacing_contract.material: Backgrounds, rules, borders, surfaces and decorative grammar must support the page's visual thesis; repeated ledger/card/rail treatment cannot be the universal premium skin.
typography_material_spacing_contract.spacing: Spacing must form a deliberate rhythm arc with meaningful compression/expansion; uniform calm spacing is not automatically premium.
typography_material_spacing_contract.transition: Section transitions must visibly change state when the persuasion arc changes state.

authored_moment_contract.definition: A screenshot-worthy authored moment is a scene where typography, media, space, material and decision logic interact in a way that is immediately recognizable without metadata.
authored_moment_contract.rule: Each page must contain clear authored focal moments beyond utility cards/ledgers; exact count is not fixed globally and must follow benchmark mechanism and page arc.
authored_moment_contract.failure: If the strongest screenshot is explainable only by its copy or image asset while the composition remains generic, the moment does not qualify.

desktop_mobile_contract.desktop: 1440 must express the intended macro silhouette, media hierarchy and authored scene sequence.
desktop_mobile_contract.mobile: 390 is independently art-directed. It may simplify but must preserve the mechanism's authority, media role, type hierarchy, state transitions and closing resolution.
desktop_mobile_contract.hard_return: Responsive survival/no overflow is insufficient if premium gestalt or media authority collapses on mobile.

hard_return_if: current page is first-glance materially tied to the rejected baseline in macro silhouette, typography, media rhythm, material grammar and focal sequence
different variants still share one dominant public pixel grammar
uniqueness comes mainly from copy/photo/color swap or added sections
same-family pages differ structurally but both still read as one design-system demo rather than authored LPs

shun_facing_acceptance_evidence.integrity_gate: If owner HTML, screenshot render input and baseline provenance cannot be proven distinct/correct, do not route to Shun.

acceptance_statement: The next implementation is complete only when benchmark qualities survive into actual owner-delivery pixels and Aoi v2 passes the blind absolute-quality gate. No internal component/trace/clone PASS can substitute.
